definitions.gloss: original text; the source in its original form
definitions.explanation: The original text of a work, as opposed to a translation, adaptation, quotation, or commentary. Often used when stressing the value of consulting a source directly rather than through a secondary version.

examples.japanese: {原典|げんてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{原典|げんてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}みたい→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I want to read it in the original, not in translation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引用|いんよう}→引用：01850_inyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正確|せいかく}→正確：03372_seikaku⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧、{原典|げんてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦{確|たし}かめた→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧。
examples.english: I went back to the original text to check whether the quotation was accurate.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {原|げん} (original) + {典|てん} (text, classic). Literally "the original text."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原典|げんてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to consult the original source directly
- {原典|げんてん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}る→戻る：01117_modoru⟧: to go back to the original text
- {原典|げんてん}⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧: textual criticism (of a source)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原文|げんぶん}→原文：20563_genbun⟧: the original wording — the actual text/wording, esp. before translation
- {原書|げんしょ}: the original book — the physical book in its original language
